Alert sample

The button below paints "Danger" semantics with the btn-danger contextual class. The visible text is also the keyword "Danger" — color is not the only means of conveying meaning to screen-reader users (they receive the word as prose), but it remains the sole signal framing that word as a status for users who cannot resolve the color channel (colorblind users on monochrome rendering, color- inverted themes, localized UIs).
